hero.title: Thank you for supporting the work of Lafayette.
hero.lede: Giving is simple and secure. If you’re just visiting, please know there’s no expectation to give.
hero.note: Opens our secure giving page on Breeze

cards.title: There’s no expectation to give
cards.body: You’re our guest. Giving is for those who call Lafayette home.

cards.title: Safe and secure
cards.body: Online gifts go through Breeze, our church’s secure giving system. You can give once or set up a recurring gift.

cards.title: In person or by mail
cards.body: [Office to confirm: giving on Sundays, and the mailing address for checks.]
